title: Binding Paraphrased Instructions to Encountered Objects in sLLM Agents under Partial Observability
abstract: arXiv:2611.07599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable deployment of LLM agents requires grounding diverse user expressions in their environments. Although RL-finetuned smaller large language model (sLLM) agents rival larger prompted LLMs on embodied tasks, their robustness to instruction paraphrases remains unclear. We introduce ALFWorld-Para to evaluate this robustness under controlled paraphrases, revealing 21-52% declines in success rates (SRs), predominantly driven by object synonyms. Despite retaining knowledge of synonym referents, agents often fail to take the corresponding objects even after observing them, exposing a gap between referential knowledge and object binding. Partial observability further complicates binding, as referents may remain unseen or have already been encountered under different labels. To address this challenge, we propose BINDIntent, a training-free framework that probabilistically binds referring expressions to observed labels using semantic proximit

translated_title: 部分可观测环境下sLLM智能体中改述指令与所遇对象的绑定
translated_abstract: LLM智能体的可靠部署需要将多样化的用户表达与其实际环境进行对接。尽管经过强化学习微调的较小规模大语言模型智能体在具身任务上可以媲美更大的提示型LLM，但它们对指令同义改述的鲁棒性仍不清楚。我们引入ALFWorld-Para基准，在受控改述条件下评估这种鲁棒性，发现成功率下降21-52%，且主要由对象同义词导致。尽管智能体保留了同义词指代对象的知识，但即使在观察到这些对象后，它们也常常无法拿取相应对象，这暴露了指称知识与对象绑定之间的差距。部分可观测性进一步使绑定问题复杂化，因为指代对象可能尚未被看到，或者已经在不同的标签名称下被遇到过。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了BINDIntent，这是一个无需训练的框架，利用语义接近度以概率方式将指称表达与观察到的标签进行绑定。
tldr: 提出了无需训练的BINDIntent框架，利用语义接近度将改述指令中的指称表达与部分可观测环境中观察到的对象标签进行概率性绑定，显著提升了sLLM智能体面对指令同义改述时的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Proposes BINDIntent, a training-free framework that probabilistically binds referring expressions in paraphrased instructions to observed object labels using semantic proximity under partial observability, significantly improving the robustness of sLLM agents against instruction paraphrases.
